verdict.rationale: Khoj documents fully local operation: you can self-host, generate embeddings on your own machine and use an offline chat model so your data never leaves the device. That keeps data out of any third-party training pipeline. However, the evidence contains no explicit statement about whether user data is used for model training, and no training opt-out for Khoj Cloud or for the commercial model providers it can call. Telemetry opt-out is a different control and is not credited here. missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out setting for Khoj Cloud, documentation of how data is handled with third-party API models, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: you can always choose to run Khoj on your own hardware, and never share your data outside of your device
You can generate your embeddings directly on your machine, and then use an offline chat client so that your data never leaves your machine.
You can even use Khoj without an internet connection if deployed on your personal computer.
